prompt: A quiet fabric made of blue threads

state.intent: A quiet fabric made of blue threads
state.evidence: Text descriptions and fixed brush parameters only. No image, drawing or pointer path is supplied.

candidates.name: Indigo loom
candidates.description: Fine blue threads cross over one another in a controlled woven ribbon. Regular, tactile and quiet.

candidates.name: Copper mesh
candidates.description: Wide warm copper strands form a loose net, with uneven crossings and open space. Rough, airy and handmade.

candidates.name: Coastal wind
candidates.description: Long sea-green hairlines bend to one side of the stroke. Windblown, fluid, light and flowing.

candidates.name: Ember drift
candidates.description: Short rust-orange filaments flick outward with sharp gusts. Restless, warm, fiery and energetic.

candidates.name: Fern script
candidates.description: A slender dark green stem sprouts paired small branches and smaller offshoots. Botanical, delicate and orderly.

candidates.name: Coral nerve
candidates.description: Asymmetric violet branches fork into restless coral-like tips. Organic, strange, tangled and lively.

candidates.name: Graphite dust
candidates.description: Small dark angular grains collect around a narrow path. Dry, soft-edged, granular and understated.

candidates.name: Pollen cloud
candidates.description: Scattered golden flecks float in a wide irregular cloud. Sunny, speckled, buoyant and soft.

candidates.name: Prism fold
candidates.description: Outlined blue angular facets fold along the stroke with a precise central spine. Architectural, crystalline and spare.

candidates.name: Rose kite
candidates.description: Broad pink diamond facets alternate across the path, like a string of paper kites. Playful, bold and geometric.
